<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="320" height="480" viewBox="0 0 320 480">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="320" height="480" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <linearGradient id="title" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="20" y1="0" x2="300" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#1d4ed8"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#be185d"/>
  </linearGradient>

  <text x="160" y="52" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle" fill="url(#title)">FrameOS</text>
  <text x="160" y="74" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748b"
        font-family="CascadiaMono">SVG <text> font demo</text>
  <line x1="20" y1="88" x2="300" y2="88" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g font-size="17" fill="#0f172a">
    <text x="20" y="116">Ubuntu, the built-in face</text>
    <text x="20" y="142" font-family="PT Sans">PT Sans, matched by name</text>
    <text x="20" y="168" font-family="PT Sans" font-weight="bold">PT Sans, asked for bold</text>
    <text x="20" y="194" font-family="Cormorant Garamond" font-style="italic" font-size="20">Cormorant, asked for italic</text>
    <text x="20" y="220" font-family="Peralta-Regular.ttf">Peralta, named by file</text>
    <text x="20" y="246" font-family="Nonesuch, sans-serif" fill="#64748b">Unknown family falls back</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="20" y1="262" x2="300" y2="262" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <line x1="160" y1="272" x2="160" y2="330" stroke="#f43f5e" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g font-size="14" fill="#0f172a">
    <text x="160" y="288" text-anchor="start">anchor start</text>
    <text x="160" y="306" text-anchor="middle">anchor middle</text>
    <text x="160" y="324" text-anchor="end">anchor end</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="20" y1="356" x2="300" y2="356" stroke="#f43f5e" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g font-size="13" fill="#0f172a">
    <text x="24" y="356" dominant-baseline="hanging">hanging</text>
    <text x="112" y="356" dominant-baseline="middle">middle</text>
    <text x="190" y="356">alphabetic</text>
  </g>

  <text x="20" y="392" font-size="15" fill="#0f172a">one <tspan fill="#0f766e"
        font-weight="bold">tspan</tspan> keeps the line going</text>
  <text x="20" y="414" font-size="15" fill="#0f172a">10°C — 07:45 — entities & caps</text>

  <g transform="translate(160 452) rotate(-5)">
    <text x="0" y="0" font-size="26" text-anchor="middle" fill="none"
          stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="0.8">outlined & rotated</text>
  </g>
</svg>
